audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: 3-year average net profit margin FY2015-FY2017 is 2.9%
audit_report.rationale: The analyst calculated the average of 3.051%, 2.271%, and 3.514% as 2.9%, but the correct average is (3.051 + 2.271 + 3.514) / 3 = 2.945%, which rounds to 2.9% only if rounding to one decimal place. However, the individual margins were rounded to one decimal in the writer's output (3.1%, 2.3%, 3.5%), and their average (3.1 + 2.3 + 3.5) / 3 = 2.967% ≈ 3.0%. The error appears to be premature rounding in the analyst stage or inconsistent rounding methodology.
